sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: modest congressional buying (small amounts, non-senior members) lacks conviction; broad market fear (36 Fear/Greed score, 41% bearish AAII) presents contrarian opportunity but absence of recent news data and neutral composite signal prevent strong directional conviction.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (384.8), flat yield curve, and earnings in 20 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for AMGN trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong trend structure (ADX strong, price above all major MAs, three white soldiers) with contrarian fear-zone opportunity (36 Fear/Greed, 41% bearish AAII) suggests institutional accumulation potential.
